name: Jordy de Ron
about: I'm Jordy de Ron, a driven and enthusiastic software engineer from the Netherlands. I have a keen eye for detail and a strong eagerness to learn. I excel at independently analyzing technical challenges and finding effective solutions. I actively invest time outside of work hours to master new methods and technologies, which demonstrates my passion for the profession. With a solid technical foundation and a hands-on mentality, I am ready to add value to any development team.
